priorityList: Summon Infernal on cooldown for major burst windows.
Activate Malevolence on cooldown, ideally while Infernal is active.
Cast Ruination as soon as it becomes available.
Cast Cataclysm to apply Wither to all targets in the area.
Spend Soul Shards on Rain of Fire when facing 4 or more enemies.
Cast Shadowburn if Malevolence or Fiendish Cruelty is active, or if there are 3 or fewer enemies.
Cast Chaos Bolt as your primary Soul Shard spender if there are 3 or fewer enemies (or 4 with Havoc active).
Apply Havoc to a secondary target if Infernal is not active and the target will live at least 8 seconds.
Cast Soul Fire to generate Soul Shards if you have fewer than 4.
Manually apply or refresh Wither on targets if Cataclysm is on cooldown and they will live longer than 8 seconds.
Cast Conflagrate if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Backdraft or need to generate Soul Shards.
Cast Incinerate as your filler spell, or to spend Backdraft stacks if Fire and Brimstone is talented.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Infernal or Malevolence windows.
